definitions.explanation: Describes a newer style, model, or method as opposed to an older one. Frequently used with の before a noun.

examples.japanese: {新式|しんしき}の{機械|きかい}を{導入|どうにゅう}した。
この{方法|ほうほう}は{新式|しんしき}だ。
examples.english: This method is the new style.

examples.japanese: {新式|しんしき}のエアコンは{電気代|でんきだい}が{安|やす}い。
examples.english: The new-model air conditioner is cheaper to run.

notes:
Composed of {新|しん} (new) + {式|しき} (style, type). It describes a model, design, or method of a newer generation. Often used with の before a noun ({新式|しんしき}の{機械|きかい}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新式|しんしき}の{機械|きかい}: a new-model machine
- {新式|しんしき}の{方法|ほうほう}: a new method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {旧式|きゅうしき}: old-style, old model — the opposite, an older design or method
